lead.question: 影星戴墨镜穿旧衣去干河床野餐，为何反被治安官当作违规者赶走？
lead.warmup: “limelight”原指舞台照明的石灰光，引申为“众人注目的中心”。本课几位影星为躲开镜头，坐古旧汽车来到干涸河床，戴墨镜、穿旧衣，做好周密防范。可他们刚把食品篮提到树荫下安顿好，一位自称治安官的人就出现了，指着“禁止野营”的布告牌要他们马上离开。化装太成功，反而没人信他们是明星。
goals: 会用 out of the limelight、take precautions、in case、get out of here、keep out of 等短语
掌握 Why don't we... 提建议句型与 needn't have done 的含义
辨别一般现在时与现在进行时的被动语态
lead.summary: 故事以 'disguises can sometimes be too perfect' 为转折：前半写四人戴墨镜、穿旧衣、做防范，把食品篮搬到树荫下；后半写治安官冷笑讥讽，既没认出明星，也不信他们自报姓名。
lead.tips: in case 表将来时后接现在时或 should，绝不接 will；另记 needn't have done（本不必却做了）与 didn't need to do 之别。

questions.zh: 为什么说他们的伪装“太完美了”？
questions.a: Because it was so convincing that the sheriff took them for ordinary campers: he did not recognize them and refused to believe they were stars, answering with a sneer, 'I'm Brinksley Meers.'
questions.aZh: 因为化装太逼真，治安官把他们当成普通野营者，根本不认得他们，还冷笑着说：“我就是布林克斯利·米尔斯。”
questions.hint: 见第 3 句与结尾 sheriff 的回答。

questions.q: What precautions had the actors taken before the picnic?
questions.zh: 野餐前演员们做了哪些防范？
questions.a: They came in an ancient bus to a dry river bed, dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, and had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
questions.aZh: 他们坐一辆古旧的汽车来到干涸的河床，戴着墨镜、穿着旧衣裳，还做了特别防范以免被认出。

questions.q: Why did the stranger order them to leave?
questions.zh: 那个陌生人为什么命令他们离开？
questions.a: He was the sheriff there. He found them camping beside a notice which said 'No Camping' and thought they were breaking the rule.
questions.aZh: 他是当地的治安官，看见他们在写着“禁止野营”的布告牌旁野餐，以为他们违反规定。
questions.hint: 见 Do you see that notice? It says 'No Camping'。

questions.q: Why did the sheriff say 'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam'?
questions.a: He said it with a sneer to mock them: he did not believe a word they said, meaning 'if you are stars, then so am I'.
questions.aZh: 他是冷笑着讥讽他们：根本不信他们的话，意思是“如果你们是明星，那我也是”。
questions.hint: 结合 said the sheriff with a sneer。

questions.q: 如果他们少化装一点，结局会怎样？这说明了标题的什么意味？
questions.zh: 如果化装没那么彻底，结局会怎样？
questions.a: If they had still looked a little like stars, the sheriff would have recognized them and probably let them stay; the story is ironic — they got what they wanted (to be out of the limelight) and lost the picnic.
questions.aZh: 若他们还多少像点明星，治安官就会认出来并多半放行。故事因此带反讽意味：他们如愿躲开了众人的目光，却丢了野餐。

exercises.q: 填空：Although he is a government official, he tries to keep ______ of the limelight.
exercises.note: out of the limelight 避开公众注意。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们戴着墨镜、穿着旧衣，采取了特别预防措施，还把两个大食品篮子提到了树荫下。
exercises.a: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions and carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.

exercises.q: 用 Why don't we... 改写建议句：Let's come here more often.
exercises.a: Why don't we come here more often?
exercises.note: Why don't we + 动词原形。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：No one recognized them, so they ______ (not take) such trouble.
填空：I'm taking a raincoat with me ______ I ______ (need) it.
选词填空（sheriff / notice / get out of here / sneer）：When the ______ appeared, he pointed to a ______ and shouted, 'Now you ______, all of you!'
exercises.a: sheriff; notice; get out of here
exercises.note: get out of here 滚开。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的适当时态、语态填空：A new notice ______ (put up) by the sheriff now, and the river bed ______ (keep) clean every day.
exercises.a: is being put up; is kept
exercises.note: 现在进行被动与一般现在被动。

quiz.q: 课文中“影迷”对应的英文是？
布告牌上“禁止野营”的规范写法是？
quiz.note: 公共标语用 no + 名词/动名词。

quiz.q: 治安官喊“你们都给我滚出去”用的是哪一句？
options: Now you get out of here, all of you!
Now you get into here, all of you!
Now you get over here, all of you!
Now you get on with it, all of you!

quiz.q: “他尽量避免引人注目”的正确表达是？
options: He tries to keep out of the limelight.
He tries to keep away the limelight.
He tries to keep off the limelight.
He tries to keep out the limelight.

quiz.q: 填入正确形式：I'm taking a raincoat with me in case I ______ it.
“他们本不必如此大费周章”应译为？
options: They needn't have taken such trouble.
They didn't need take such trouble.
They hadn't need to take such trouble.
